why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Pick a Senpi plan Points are tied to a Senpi subscription plan, and the rate rises with the tier. Compare the tiers on the Senpi pricing page .
2 Step 2 : Sign in and set up your agent Open the Senpi site or the iOS app or Android app and sign in. Then choose a template, describe a strategy, or copy a trader.

3 Step 3 : Fund a strategy and trade perps Each strategy runs in its own sub-wallet and needs funding, starting from $10 USDC (see strategy types and the sub-wallet model ). Each $1 of perps volume you then trade earns points automatically at your plan's rate. Nothing needs to be claimed.
4 Step 4 : Check your points and rank Open the Senpi points page to see your points and the Top Senpi Ninjas leaderboard. Totals refresh about every 10 minutes, and the leaderboard may take longer.
